release_notes: Added five deterministic formations: sine train, pincer, rotating orbit, dive chain, and double helix.
Added choreographed lane fans, crossing bursts, rings, aimed pairs, spirals, pre-fire tells, motion trails, and pattern-chain scoring.
Gravity now affects only the runner; legacy synchronization telemetry remains compatible but inert.
Live simulation result: 23.8 seconds, seven formations, all five patterns, 36 kills, ×6 chain, two lives remaining, and 436 px vertical spread.
`npm test` passes and the production web export builds successfully.
